method: Border-connected near-white extraction with optional recorded interior background seeds and pale-anatomy protection; recipe-specific edge alpha matting and color decontamination. No global white deletion. Whole-group placement is recorded separately.

matte.calibrationNote: Modal native outer-eight-pixel matte; exterior-connected extraction, preserving enclosed highlights. White surfaces and internal background gaps are inspected per object.
matte.componentCleanupNote: Pass 01 dark preview exposes detached white matte specks and pale edge residue outside the dark wood/brass object. The calibrated 238 threshold preserves its internal highlights while removing exterior-connected matte.

inspection: Transparent light/dark specimens and rounded presentation inspected. White/ivory physical surfaces, metal reflections, interior recesses and opaque printed details preserved. Enclosed background seeds are explicitly recorded where used.
